args: At NodesHub, we are a professional blockchain infrastructure provider specializing in validator services, RPC endpoints, and IBC relaying. With extensive experience across diverse ecosystems, we deliver robust, secure, and highly available infrastructure for Web3 networks.  Networks You Are Currently Validating: We actively validate on 40+ blockchain networks, including Cosmos-based chains and emerging smart contract platforms. Our infrastructure is optimized for uptime, performance, and rapid recovery.  Full List of Networks: https://nodeshub.online/ Links to Your Digital Presence: •Website: https://nodeshub.online •X\\\(Twitter\\\): https://x.com/Nodes_Hub •GitHub: https://github.com/NodesHub Contact Details: •Email: contact@nodeshub.online •Telegram: https://t.me/V_NodesHub •Discord ID: nodeshub Why You Are Interested in Validating on gno.land: We are excited to support Gno.land because of its modular design, developer-first philosophy, and community-centric values all of which align with our mission at NodesHub. Our team shares the long-term vision of building decentralized, composable, and developer-friendly ecosystems, and we’re eager to contribute to Gno.land as it grows.  Contributions to gno.land: - Public RPC Infrastructure: We will deploy and maintain reliable public RPC endpoints to support developers and indexers. - Snapshot Services: Daily snapshot generation for faster node synchronization and chain onboarding - IBC Relayer Support: We plan to enable seamless IBC connections as soon as Gno.land supports IBC integrations - Community Engagement: Active involvement in governance, forums, and contributing to documentation and tooling as needed.
